Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati is 14th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. Degree along with at least 2 years of experience in solar thermal system performance analysis.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 49000 per month, plus 16% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate position at IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the IIT Guwahati Research Associate job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is strictly online through the official IIT Guwahati website.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is IITG/II&SI/Project Staff Rectt-2026/148.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Guwahati.
